title: Building an Optimal Code, Two Symbols at a Time
summary: Step through Huffman's greedy construction and see why merging the two rarest symbols yields a code no other prefix code can beat.

sources.title: D. A. Huffman, A Method for the Construction of Minimum-Redundancy Codes, Proc. IRE 40(9), 1952
